newsitem.title: UK: NWE GAS OIL FALLS $3 WITH IPE, DIFFS HOLD STEADY.
newsitem.headline: NWE GAS OIL FALLS $3 WITH IPE, DIFFS HOLD STEADY.

text.p: NWE gas oil was $3.00 or so weaker on Friday as falling IPE futures pulled prices lower.
Barge premiums were very narrowly easier, but cargo held firm.
August IPE gas oil closed $3.00 off at $169.25 with September also down $3.00 at $171.25.
In the barge market differentials were about 50 cents easier amid increased buying interest that was prompted from a $7.00 a tonne drop in prices since August 5.
A second half August heating oil barge sold at September flat with first half August pegged around +50 cents against August.
Cargo premiums were steady with FOD pegged around +50-$1.00 cif with DIN attracting a 50 cent premium.
Traders said it was quiet on the cargo front with only a couple of deals seen . An EN590 cargo traded at $4.85 cif NWE for second half August delivery.
